slot_note: Seed AD33's world (a data-centre battery's FCR-D offer) sits only in energy-systems-utilities/grid-reliability-outage-analysis, held by task402 inside the live window (ban.subdomain), so the draw moved to another client domain, world and dataset under the same objective and number (CLAUDE.md, A stuck build is unblocked).
niche: a limestone quarry's January haul allocation on a new extension road, held to the noise management plan's haulage share of the village noise limit and sized on the sound exposure each haul movement in view of the village monitor delivers
analyst_test: A strong analyst who converts the logger's UTC period-end stamps, counts the haul movements from the telematics and reads every condition and the noise plan's share, plant level and residual correctly fits each working hour's energy at the village monitor against its movements and divides the share by the average movement's energy: fifteen trucks, where only the movements that climbed out of the pit onto the original ground carry the extension road's per-movement energy and allow three; the careful variants file six (per face), nine (crusher tips), two or seven (BS 5228 from declared sound power) and one (BS 5228 calibrated on the pooled record).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the sound exposure one haul movement in line of sight delivers at the receptor, estimated by apportioning the monitor's measured sound energy among the movements by the route each one ran, which is the source-attribution work of environmental noise monitoring; with another field's nouns there is no energy summation, no screening by the pit face and no receptor, and the call stops reading.
layer1: the monitor's 15-minute records stamped at the period end on a UTC logger clock
telematics fixes in UTC against the site's local clock across the 26 October change
telematics positions in WGS84 latitude and longitude with GPS scatter against the survey's CRS84 export
two Saturday battery gaps in the monitor record
the belt scale's interval-start stamps on the site clock beside the monitor's period-end stamps
the June 2026 product code renumbering against January tickets
portable axle weigher records keyed into the weighbridge system with the next Monday's batch
the crusher controller's stop logged at boot after a supply interruption
the wheel loader's unordered buckets (reclaim feed and re-handling) in one payload log

world.geography: England, a fictional limestone quarry and village in the north of England
world.org_type: an aggregates company operating one limestone quarry

driver: The decisive quantity is the exposure one unit of an activity delivers at a receptor in the configuration the forward plan runs, and because the record mixes units that ran in that configuration with units screened from the receptor and nothing in the record says which ran where, an exposure calibrated on the whole record, or taken from the units' declared ratings, misstates it; only each unit's own position track read against a survey of the ground separates the two.
driver_concrete: Each haul movement's sound exposure at the village monitor depends on whether it climbed out of the pit onto Haul road 2 over the original ground or stayed in the pit or behind the plant compound's bund, which no ticket records and only the trucks' GPS tracks against the site survey show; the January extension road is set out over the same ground at Haul road 2's distances from the monitor, so its per-movement exposure is the Haul road 2 movements' own, which allows three trucks where the average movement allows fifteen and the declared-sound-power prediction two or seven.
stump: A competent solver calibrates the haul movements' exposure at the village monitor on the whole monitoring record, or predicts it from the plant register's declared sound power, and allocates eight or more trucks to the January extension road; the step that lands them there is pooling movements screened in the pit with the movements that ran in view of the village.

differentiation.task488: task488 equates new test items to an established scale through the members each was given to (an ETL conformance of levels); this build apportions a monitor's sound energy among haul movements by the route each ran, a physical source attribution with no scale or calibration sample.
differentiation.task122: task122 v4 reads a discretionary aid's effect against working periods that hold more of one kind of unit (a composition confound on a causal comparison); this build has no intervention or comparison of arms, and its decisive state is each movement's line of sight to a receptor, read from position tracks against a survey.

notes: Moved from seed AD33's battery world (energy grid reliability, banned by task402's subdomain in the window). Screened and rejected before this card: rain-induced radon-progeny washout at a fence-line gamma network (the golden needs a fitted dynamic model; event routes land 6 to 12 nSv/h off), occupational blood lead (task181 shared-resource and task182 lagged-response abstractions), UPS battery thermal age and uptime counters (task139's wear clock), hydropeaking under a rating curve (task156's level from a separate record). Stage 4 round 1 fix pass (2026-11-04): the noise plan files the residual measured with the site stopped; the hopper moved onto a bearing between the pit and the Phase 4 extension so the Phase 4 road is set out over the same ground at Haul road 2's distances (every road-level, line-of-sight and BS 5228 measure within 0.022 dB); the realism list from the leak reader regenerated (complaints, multi-load orders, weekday profile, declarations by model).
